decision.explanation: The provided evidence (pmid-25686603:f01) describes the sensitivity of BCR-ABL1 V299L mutant Ba/F3 cells to axitinib. It does not contain any data regarding the FLT3 D835Y variant, the drug Gilteritinib, or the disease context of pre-malignant neoplasm. Consequently, there is no evidence to support, revise, or refute the claim that Gilteritinib shows sensitivity/response in pre-malignant neoplasm with FLT3 D835Y (SOMATIC). The available source is entirely unrelated to the entities in the claim.

citations.quote: In a proliferation assay measuring tritiated thymidine incorporation in the presence of axitinib, Ba/F3 cells carrying the BCR-ABL1 variant showed decreased incorporation when harboring fusions with the V299L variant of ABL1 compared to fusions with wildtype ABL1 (IC50 of 188nM vs. 823 nM), indicating V299L induces sensitivity compared to BCR-ABL1 without secondary variants.
